about: Past tables rebuilt by tools/history/build_archived.py: for each, the tools/tables builder, the year, and which history sources (Internet Archive copies) make each of its input files, joined in order. Every copy must be captured in the build's year.

builds.note: IMT's 2024 pages, one per motorway; the A32 page has no 2024 copy and the former SCUT roads (electronic tolls, abolished on 1 January 2025) have no page, so neither is priced.
